configuration:
seed: 42
study: unstained_finland_20261002_v1_pyramid_seed42
output_dir: <local path>
data:
  task: unstained_to_he
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: <local path>
  val_manifest: <local path>
  test_manifest: <local path>
  crop_size: 256
  workers: 4
  persistent_workers: false
  timeout: 0
  unpaired: false
model:
  name: pyramid_resnet
  in_channels: 3
  base_channels: 64
  blocks: 9
  dropout: true
pyramid:
  weights:
  - 25.0
  - 25.0
  - 25.0
  - 25.0
  signed_range: true
  charbonnier: false
loss:
  perceptual: 0.0
gan:
  discriminator: bci
  base_channels: 64
  scales: 1
  objective: bce
  lambda_gan: 1.0
  lambda_feature_matching: 0.0
  start_epoch: 1
  lr: 0.0002
  betas:
  - 0.5
  - 0.999
ema:
  enabled: false
  decay: 0.999
train:
  epochs: 200
  constant_epochs: 100
  decay_epochs: 100
  batch_size: 8
  lr: 0.0002
  betas:
  - 0.5
  - 0.999
  amp: fp32
  grad_clip: null
  log_every: 50
  monitor_every: 500
  max_seconds: 108000
  reference_steps_per_epoch: 900
  until_plateau: true
  min_lr_ratio: 0.05
validation:
  lpips: true
  selection_metric: lpips
  fp32: true
  unpadded: true
  selection_mode: min
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 20
    min_delta: 0.0
    warmup_steps: 9900
    warmup_epochs: 10
    warmup_checks: 10
    reset_during_warmup: true
unstained_protocol:
  id: finland_unstained_he_v1
  species: mouse
  manifest_sha256:
    train: 418b0fcb5dd3d0f4befd6b250960759e77796036b254f67c623cb7b16bddbc85
    val: d9e29b810b66e089794a8d08f29efc69c0f5d6ad98e0b9ebaf4d0c1c3182ee29
    test: 828105fc969074883d5279f66e003238ea6f73353866aaa3828721efa63990e9
  selection: minimum validation AlexNet LPIPS
  split_identity: Slide-disjoint; animal independence unverified. Not the published
    test split.
  geometry: Existing non-overlapping 1024x1024 tiles, 0.353 um/pixel; joint random
    native 256 crops for training, fixed native 256 center crops for evaluation; no
    resize.
  seed_replicates: 1
  status: production
  recipe: Audited local method adaptation; not an exact author reproduction.

remaining_metrics.GigaPath_MRA: Not implemented in this evaluator; published metric requires separate GigaPath weights and retrieval protocol.
remaining_metrics.PaPIS: Requires published metric encoder/protocol; FM cosine is not PaPIS.
remaining_metrics.HSFI: Published domain-specific nuclei/architecture/colour weights and clinical assessment protocol are not reproduced.
remaining_metrics.annotated_cell_accuracy: No manually annotated cell references; nucleus scores are detector agreement.
